compiled_state.title: UPDATE: Register integration review scope test in .test-index
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
Register the new test file from Task 1 in .test-index so the pre-commit test gate and CI discover it.

Add the following entry to .test-index:
  .github/workflows/ci.yml:tests/workflows/test-ci-integration-review-scope.sh

This appends to the existing ci.yml entry line (.github/workflows/ci.yml currently maps to tests/scripts/test-ci-hyperfine-installed.sh,tests/scripts/test-ci-consolidated-changes-detection.sh). The new test must be added to that comma-separated list.

Verify with: grep 'test-ci-integration-review-scope' .test-index

Testing mode: UPDATE
